image_description: A close-up, horizontal view of a vintage audio cassette tape resting on a textured red fabric background. The cassette has a dark gray/black plastic housing with a cream-colored paper label on the top face. The internal spools and magnetic tape are visible through the standard circular windows. There is a digital-style date stamp '2019 JUL' in the bottom left corner.
